text:
Maya Li: Cobalt Data asks for a 6-month private POC. They want eu-central1, dedicated pool, and requested 26% off + onboarding waived. Can we accept without exec?

Owen Price: 26% is above our usual pilot band. What do they offer in committment?

Rami Haddad: They can prepay $110k upfront. Usage estimate: ~700M tokens/mo -> ~$21k/mo list -> ~$126k over 6mo. Infra + onboarding cost ~18k.

Ivy Tran (deal-desk): Standard comps: 15% + $10k credit, 20% if prepaid >= $150k, or 18% + 9mo convertible clause. For $110k prepay, recommend 15% + credit.

Legal: They want a data residency clause and "no model retention" language. We'll propose: 90-day prompt retention, provider retains model artifacts. Need DPA and limited indemnity change.

sec-bot: Security checklist: SOC2 present, KMS plan required, network diagram needed. 90-day retention acceptable with DPA and PII handling.

Maya Li: Customer says $110k is max. They push for waived onboarding but will accept $5k credit.

Owen Price: 15% + $5k credit with prepaid $110k is acceptable. Ops can do soft-provision on wire.

Ivy Tran (deal-desk): I'll accept 15% + $5k onboarding credit conditioned on: 1) $110k wire confirmation, 2) signed DPA with 90-day retention, 3) SecOps sign-off. If any item fails, escalate to Sarah.

Maya Li: I'll ask procurement for wire and send DPA draft tonight. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
